paper.title_en: Critical Temperatures of Excited Holographic Superconductors in Born--Infeld Electrodynamics on a Reissner--Nordström--AdS Background
paper.abstract_en: We study the ground state (GS) and the two lowest excited states (ES1, ES2) of a probe holographic superconductor with Born-Infeld (BI) electrodynamics on a charged Reissner-Nordstrom-AdS (RN-AdS) black hole background. The small-to-large black hole (SBH/LBH) transition used to modulate the boundary theory requires the electric charge Q: the neutral Schwarzschild-AdS metric admits only one positive horizon for any M,L^2>0 and cannot support such a transition. Working on the correctly identified RN-AdS geometry, we set up the scalar/BI-gauge probe sector, formulate the linear eigenvalue problem for the onset of condensation, and solve it by a shooting method. We obtain T_c of GS, ES1, ES2 at three representative pressures (P>P_c, P=P_c, P<P_c) and five values of the BI parameter b in {0,1,2,3,5} Q^-1. T_c increases monotonically with P and is suppressed by b for all three states, more for the excited states (~2% for GS versus ~10-27% for ES1/ES2 at b=5 Q^-1). A finer scan in b shows the suppression follows a quadratic law T_c(b)/T_c(0)=1-alpha b^2, with alpha(GS)~7.4e-4, alpha(ES1)~4.1e-3, alpha(ES2)~1.1e-2, consistent with the radial profiles of the threshold modes: the ground-state mode is concentrated near the horizon, while the nodal excited-state modes extend further into the bulk. We present this as a nodal-sensitivity picture rather than a proven mechanism, and make it concrete with an explicit leading-order BI correction to the bulk gauge field: this differential coupling between nonlinear electrodynamics and the node structure of excited condensates has not previously been isolated and quantified, independently of the back-reacted problem left to a companion study. These results clarify how BI nonlinearity interacts with the nodal structure of excited states, giving a sharper linear baseline for the back-reacted, finite-temperature holographic superconductor.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 本文研究了在RN-AdS背景下具有Born-Infeld电动力学的激发全息超导体，重点关注节点结构与非线性电动力学之间的相互作用。作为一篇hep-th论文，它符合全息凝聚态物理的主题，并提供了理论深度、方法严谨性和新颖性。作者通过射击法求解特征值问题，提供了数值结果和定性图片，虽未证明机制，但清晰地呈现了结果。论文历史和研究内容使其成为该领域的有价值补充。
decision.title_zh: 在Reissner–Nordström–AdS背景上Born–Infeld电动力学激发全息超导体的临界温度
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在带电Reissner-Nordstrom-AdS (RN-AdS)黑洞背景上具有Born-Infeld (BI)电动力学的探针全息超导体的基态(GS)和两个最低激发态(ES1, ES2)。用于调节边界理论的小-大黑洞(SBH/LBH)转变需要电荷Q：中性Schwarzschild-AdS度规对任何M,L^2>0只允许一个正视界，不能支持这种转变。在正确识别的RN-AdS几何上，我们建立了标量/BI规范探针扇区，制定了凝聚开始时的线性特征值问题，并用射击法求解。我们在三个代表性压力(P>P_c, P=P_c, P<P_c)和五个BI参数b在{0,1,2,3,5}Q^-1下的值处获得GS、ES1、ES2的T_c。T_c随P单调增加，并且对于所有三个态都受b抑制，对于激发态抑制更明显（在b=5Q^-1时，GS约为2%，而ES1/ES2约为10-27%）。在b中更精细的扫描表明，抑制遵循二次定律T_c(b)/T_c(0)=1-alpha b^2，其中alpha(GS)~7.4e-4，alpha(ES1)~4.1e-3，alpha(ES2)~1.1e-2，与阈值模式的径向轮廓一致：基态模式集中在视界附近，而节点激发态模式延伸到体内部更远处。我们将其作为节点敏感性图景而非已证实的机制提出，并通过体规范场的显式前导阶BI修正使其具体化：非线性电动力学与激发凝聚物的节点结构之间的这种微分耦合以前没有被独立地分离和量化，并留给伴随研究中的背景反作用问题。这些结果阐明了BI非线性如何与激发态的节点结构相互作用，为背景反作用、有限温度的全息超导体提供了更清晰的线性基线。
